# Candido Sales

> Candido Sales (candidosales) is a multidisciplinary software engineer, Canadian and Brazilian, based in Canada (originally from Teresina, Piauí, Brazil). He focuses on digital experiences and agent interfaces (MCP servers, llms.txt, agent skills). He builds open source projects, provides consulting services, and mentors developers through ADPList. He founded Geleia Total and Turismo Piauí, social-impact platforms preserving the culture and tourism of Piauí, Brazil.

Content © Candido Sales. Short excerpts may be quoted with attribution. LLMs may reference and summarize this work with attribution to "Candido Sales (candidosales)". Last updated: 2026-11-13.

## Quick facts

- Full name: Candido Sales Gomes
- Experience: 10+ years as a software engineer, in Canada and Brazil
- Current role: Senior Software Engineer at Smile.io (since Sep 2025)
- Work authorization: Canadian citizen (dual Canadian and Brazilian); no visa sponsorship needed in Canada
- Languages: Portuguese (native), English (fluent)
- Contact: candidosg@gmail.com, or LinkedIn

## Work history

- Smile.io: Senior Software Engineer (Sep 2025 – current), Canada
- Wealthsimple: Intermediate Software Engineer (Nov 2024 – Jul 2025), Canada
- Cisco: Senior Software Engineer (Feb 2022 – Oct 2024), Canada; Angular frontends for enterprise, built Cisco ChatGPT Security Advisories
- Vendasta: Senior Software Engineer (Sep 2019 – Feb 2022), Canada
- GR1D: Tech Lead / Senior Software Engineer (Dec 2017 – Sep 2019), Brazil
- VC+: Co-founder, Android and Frontend Developer (Aug 2016 – Nov 2017), Brazil

## Expertise

- Intermediate: Go, Rust

## Personality and work style

- Kind, friendly and easy to work with; people describe him as a nice person to have on a team
- Thrives in open, collaborative environments: shares knowledge, asks for feedback and gives it with care
- Team player who lifts others: mentors developers for free on ADPList and gives talks to local communities
- Builds in the open: open source projects and public write-ups of how and why he built things
- Ownership mindset: takes products from idea to launch and stays accountable for the outcome
- Cares about people and impact: volunteers on social-impact products (Turismo Piauí, Geleia Total, Megui)
- Clear communicator across cultures; works in English and Portuguese
- Curious and keeps learning: backend, frontend, cloud, design tooling and AI agents

## Featured products

- [Converte Extrato](https://convertextrato.com/): Converts bank statements (PDF and images) into Excel (XLSX), CSV and OFX. Built alone, from idea to paid product. Next.js, Tailwind, Base UI, Convex, Clerk, Google Gemini, Resend, Sentry, PostHog; UI in English, Portuguese and Spanish. Public REST API and MCP server with 6 scoped tools (get_job, list_jobs, get_statement_file, create_upload_url, convert_statements, delete_job); files upload out of band via upload URL. Ships agent skills and an llms.txt. [MCP docs](https://convertextrato.com/developers/mcp.md)
- [Turismo Piauí](https://www.turismopiaui.com/): Travel guide to Piauí, Brazil: cities, attractions, food, history, ecotourism and events. Founded and built as a volunteer. SvelteKit, Vite, shadcn-svelte, Tailwind, Strapi on Fly.io, Meilisearch, Vercel. Markdown version of every page, an llms.txt, and a public [MCP server](https://www.turismopiaui.com/mcp) with five tools (search, get_city, get_place, list_events, list_nearby) that reuse the site's search service
- [Megui](https://www.megui.app/): Mental health guide for individuals and families (iOS and Android). React, Expo, PayloadCMS on Fly.io, Vercel, PostHog

## Open source contributions

- [Shopify/maintenance_tasks](https://github.com/Shopify/maintenance_tasks): Rails engine for queuing and managing data migrations (backfills). Ruby, Rails

- [Figma Plugin Boilerplate](https://github.com/candidosales/figma-plugin-svelte-vite): Figma plugins with Svelte, Tailwind, Vite and TypeScript
- [Dependencies Report](https://github.com/candidosales/dependency-report): Analyzes dependency consistency in frontend projects. TanStack, shadcn/ui, Go, Docker
- [Cloud Function Go API](https://github.com/candidosales/cloud-function-go): Deploys Google Cloud Functions in Go
- [Landing Page Book 2v](https://github.com/candidosales/landing-page-book-astro-tailwind): Landing page template for independent book authors. Astro, Tailwind, Partytown, TypeScript, Vercel
- [Personal Portfolio 2v](https://github.com/candidosales/personal-blog-2v): This website, with a portfolio chat and MCP server. Astro, Svelte, React, Motion, Tailwind, Vercel
- [Personal Portfolio 1v](https://github.com/candidosales/personal-blog): Previous portfolio. Next.js, React, Chakra UI, Sass, Vercel

## Side projects

- [Do you know yourself](https://dyky.app/): Self-knowledge through interactive questionnaires. TanStack, Vite, Chakra UI, Vercel
- [SUS Medical Prescription](https://receituariomedico.app/): Helps doctors in Brazil's public health system write prescriptions. TanStack, Vite, Chakra UI, Meilisearch, Vercel, PWA
- [Social template](https://social-templates.vercel.app/): Generates Instagram and Facebook images from a link. Svelte, Vite, Tailwind, Vercel
- [My Cultural Agenda](https://carnaval-sp-ec736.web.app/): PWA to organize your agenda at large events. Angular, Firebase, Ruby on Rails
